levels.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: «بهذا الحديث» refers to the matn, not to a chain: no item is written for it
«قال بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب» has Umar as the subject of the event told by سالم, not a link (rule 6)

Tirmidhi's note («الصحيح حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه») and «قد روي عن مالك أيضا عن الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه» state routes about the report; the second is an isnad after the saying and is not written here
«قال محمد» in the note is al-Bukhari; he is not a link of this report
needs_ruling: whether the note's route through مالك and «أبيه» (Umar's son, by relation) is to be written as a further group cannot be settled from the rules
